reviews.title: Good Product, Poor Service
reviews.review_text: Tires are good and purchased them on sale. Also scheduled and paid for installation at my local Walmart at the same time as tire purchase. Arrived to my appointment 15 minutes early, staff arrived late. Got checked in, they said they would text when done and expected it to take about an hour. An hour and fifteen minutes later, I hear my name over the PA system and was asked to return to the auto center, never receiving a text. Made my way back to the auto center where I was informed that they were unable to put my new tires on because they lift was out of service. I asked the staff if they could call the next closest Walmart Auto Center to see if they could install them. We waited for 20 minutes on hold and finally were informed that they had the proper lift, lift was in working order, and they had time to install them. It took me 8 minutes to drive there, waited 20 minutes to have someone check me in, was told that it would be about an hour and that they would text me. After an hour and a half, I went back to the auto center to see if they were about done and noticed that my car was still in the original place I parked it. I asked a staff member how much longer it would be and they told me that they couldn't to it because the lift they needed wasn't working. They suggested that I take my tires and go to Firestone for installation. Although they refunded my installation fees, I went to Discount Tire for installation which costed me double what I was refunded since I didn't buy the tires from them, but they had them installed in about 30 minutes. I would recommend the tires but would not recommend Walmart Auto Centers in Wetumpka or Pratville, AL.

Space you are pursue this with FedEx somehow or with Walmart thanks for help.

reviews.title: Pirelli P Zero All Season UHP All Season 215/55R17
Only 30,000 miles works.
reviews.review_text: I drove with this tire around 25,000 miles for my commuter. My daily drive mile is 150 miles, and I purchased this in July 2024. So my point is that this tire is only able to make 30,000 miles. I think that the maximum. The price is very reasonable, but if you think about brand quality from Pirelli, This is not a great option. I am moving to HanKook tire. Kinergy GT or PT. That tire easily makes over 50,000 miles and even 70,000 miles.
